PUT.name: S&P 500 PutWrite
PUT.rule: Sells a one-month at-the-money SPX put each month (3rd Friday), fully collateralised by one- and three-month T-bills.

WPUT.name: S&P 500 One-Week PutWrite
WPUT.rule: Sells an at-the-money SPX put every week, collateralised by one-month T-bills.

PUTY.name: S&P 500 2% OTM PutWrite
PUTY.rule: Sells a 2% out-of-the-money SPX put monthly, collateralised by one-month T-bills.

PUTR.name: Russell 2000 PutWrite
PUTR.rule: Sells an at-the-money RUT put monthly, collateralised by one-month T-bills.

BXM.name: S&P 500 BuyWrite
BXM.rule: Long the S&P 500, sells a one-month at-the-money SPX call each month.

BXMD.name: S&P 500 30-Delta BuyWrite
BXMD.rule: Long the S&P 500, sells the monthly SPX call with delta closest to 0.30.

BXY.name: S&P 500 2% OTM BuyWrite
BXY.rule: Long the S&P 500, sells a one-month 2% out-of-the-money SPX call.

BXMW.name: S&P 500 Multi-Week BuyWrite
BXMW.rule: Four staggered short at-the-money SPX/SPXW calls, one written each week ~4 weeks out.

BXR.name: Russell 2000 BuyWrite
BXR.rule: Long the Russell 2000, sells a one-month at-the-money RUT call.

CNDR.name: S&P 500 Iron Condor
CNDR.rule: Monthly SPX (AM-settled): sells ~0.20Δ call and −0.20Δ put, buys ~0.05Δ wings; strikes set before 11:00 ET on the 3rd-Friday roll; T-bill account of 10× the max loss (≈10% max loss).

BFLY.name: S&P 500 Iron Butterfly
BFLY.rule: Monthly SPX: sells the at-the-money put and call, buys 5% out-of-the-money wings; T-bill account sized to limit the downside.

CLL.name: S&P 500 95-110 Collar
CLL.rule: Long the S&P 500, buys quarterly 5% OTM puts, sells monthly 10% OTM calls.

CLLZ.name: S&P 500 Zero-Cost Put Spread Collar
CLLZ.rule: Long the S&P 500, buys a monthly 2.5% OTM put, sells a 5% OTM put, and sells an OTM call struck to pay for the put spread.

PPUT.name: S&P 500 5% Put Protection
PPUT.rule: Long the S&P 500 plus a monthly 5% out-of-the-money SPX put.

RXM.name: S&P 500 Risk Reversal
RXM.rule: Buys a monthly 0.25Δ SPX call and sells a −0.25Δ put, collateralised by T-bills.

CMBO.name: S&P 500 Covered Combo
CMBO.rule: Long the S&P 500, sells a 2% OTM call and an at-the-money put monthly (a covered strangle).

SVRPO.name: S&P 500 Market-Neutral VRP Optimized
SVRPO.rule: Writes one-month SPX calls and puts and buys cheaper wings to harvest the volatility risk premium with low equity beta; T-bills cover the maximum loss.

VPD.name: VIX Premium Strategy
VPD.rule: Short the next monthly VIX future over a T-bill account, sized so a 25-point VIX jump keeps 75% of the portfolio.
